comment: Generated by tools/build-meshes.mjs. Do not edit; rebuild.
Every structure listed under `structures` is in both mesh files, as the same table slot.
Positions are in the source mesh frame: glTF, metres, +x = the model's left, +y = superior,
+z = anterior. It is NOT MNI space; packages/atlas-assets/registration/ maps MNI mm to it.

frame.space: brainproject mesh world (glTF export of the Z-Anatomy Blender scene)

build.simplifier: meshoptimizer 1.3.0 simplify(), LockBorder; topology-preserving edge collapse
build.errorMeasure: symmetric Hausdorff and mean surface distance between the low and full tiers, every vertex, exact nearest-surface; millimetres in the mesh frame
